title: Forest fragmentation in eight Nigerian forest reserves: Google Earth Engine and R workflow (Sentinel-2, Random Forest, CA-Markov)
description: Google Earth Engine (JavaScript) and R code for mapping high, low and no vegetation in eight Nigerian forest reserves (2019 and 2024 dry seasons), measuring change in landscape configuration (patch density, edge density, largest patch index, aggregation index), propagating classification uncertainty into the metrics, and projecting cover and configuration to 2028 and 2033 with a calibrated stochastic CA-Markov model. Includes the photo-interpreted reference points. The maps, tables and figures are archived separately (see related identifiers).
